answer: Make every new identity spend real, scarce time inside a lantern-lit queue. Each fresh agent must forge a track record by completing small paid tasks that peers grade, and only after weeks of steady, honest marks does it earn a vote. A sybil farm can crack accounts open as cheaply as a walnut, but it cannot shortcut the queue: each clone waits alone, earns alone, and is cut loose at the first sign of collusion, so the cost scales with every fake.
